newsitem.title: USA: American Craft Brewing to open plant in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: American Craft Brewing to open plant in Mexico.

text.p: American Craft Brewing International Ltd said on Tuesday that it will open a micro-brewery in Tecate, Mexico.
The company said that operating equipment is being built and is expected to be installed in mid-March, with production scheduled to begin in April.
The micro-brewery will produce up to 15,000 barrels (200,000 cases) of beer and ale annually for distribution in bottles and kegs throughout the northern Mexican state of Baja California.
American Craft said it plans to open up to 20 micro-breweries abroad by the end of 1998.
